newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 23.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Intercontinental Hotel Consortium signs protocol with Ivory Coast government on refurbishment and future running of Abidjan's top hotel, the Ivoire. The consortium plans to invest 32 billion CFA over two years to renovate the hotel and ensure its commercial development. A separate company will be set up to manage the hotel.

- Ivory Coast's president, Henri Konan Bedie, is among a group of African presidents who win U.S. government award in recognition of their help for development of the private sector in the continent. Others include the presidents of Uganda, Ethiopia, South Africa and Mozambique.

- Five companies submitted initial offers as part of the privatisation of Ivory Coast's SODESUCRE sugar company. Offers concern Ferke I and Ferke II, Borotou and Zuenoula sugar complexes. Final offers must be in by May 30. Various companies include French, British, Senegalese, South African and Ivorian interests.
